### Affected Documentation

Which file or section needs updating? (e.g., `README.md`, `docs/implementation/configuration.md`, `docs/queue-driver.md`, `docs/event-integration.md`, `docs/webhook-push.md`, `docs/messages/*`, CHANGELOG)

### What Is Missing or Incorrect?

Describe what's unclear, outdated, or absent.

### Suggested Changes

Provide a detailed description — or a draft — of the proposed wording, examples, or diagrams.

### Why Is This Needed?

Explain who benefits and how (e.g., new adopters, users moving from another queue driver, microservice integrators, contributors).

### Additional Context

Links to related issues, PRs, Google Cloud Pub/Sub docs, or external references.
